title: CreatorOps Studio Unified Poster

copy.headline: One unified studio replaces four subscriptions
copy.support: Manage your entire creator business from a single powerful dashboard.

concept: Clean, modern, and airy illustration showing four floating app windows merging smoothly into one bright, central creative studio hub representing unified CreatorOps.

design_system.style: clean modern vector illustration with soft gradients, layered rounded shapes, and subtle drop shadows
design_system.lighting: bright top-left studio illumination casting soft downward shadows

composition.hero: A central glowing rounded rectangle studio window in primary blue, surrounded by four smaller translucent app cards converging inward via curved dotted arrows, all rendered in vector gradients.
props: floating sparkle icons near the center hub
tiny productivity pills floating around the edges
soft colored gradient blur circles behind the hero
composition.background: Soft vertical gradient from top F8FAFC to bottom EDF2F7 with faint large abstract rounded rectangles in the corners.
decor: large pale indigo faint pill shape on top right
large pale pink soft blur circle on bottom left
